moments.author: Donald J. Trump
moments.quote: AI‑generated video of me wrestling and hugging a tiger, hours after posting real footage of a fatal mauling
moments.why: It’s sparking outrage—men are debating the shocking tone‑deaf humor and what it says about media and leadership.

moments.author: Piers Morgan
moments.quote: This is appallingly tasteless. Delete it, President @realDonaldTrump.
moments.why: A blunt condemnation from a high-profile commentator fuels the viral backlash cycle.

moments.author: Patricia Eguino
moments.why: Straight‑up scathing take reflecting how the video is being read as a sign of mental instability.

moments.author: Harry Sisson
moments.quote: This man is demented and mentally unwell.
moments.why: Captures the visceral, meme‑ready outrage dominating discussions among men 25‑45.
